description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.

hot_issues.title: Window is completely white (blank) (powertoys/FancyZones, flutter not ok, sciter ok)
Audio latency will keep accumulating, causing lag and inconsistency
scrolling with trackpad+mouse is very fast

discussions.title: iOS/iPadOS: Support multiple simultaneous remote sessions (multi-window / Split View)
Display a notification on the controlled device when the controlling side starts recording a remote session
Ubuntu budgie 26.04 (wayland) remote access on a local Win11 Pro system: CPU usage is too high
local-ip-addr does not prevent the client from advertising WAN IP to the server
Feature request: automatic input priority for the local user on the controlled machine
Change resolution to (0,0) disconnects the X11 output and breaks capture (displays len: 0)
